title: PIXL 8000 Strawberry Burst Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Burst from PIXL 8000 captures the bold sweetness of ripe Strawberries in a punchy, juicy vape. A crowd-pleaser with simple, fruity satisfaction at its heart. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes with a 10ml refill reservoir. Used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup supports up to 8000 puffs with consistent vapour and flavour from the mesh coil. Perfect for MTL vaping with draw-activation and Boost Mode support, Strawberry Burst is ideal for vapers who enjoy classic, vibrant fruit flavours.
